title: PlasmaZones Animation Shader Metadata
description: metadata.json for a bundled or user animation-shader pack. Core identity and the parameter contract are enforced. Optional rendering keys (vertexShader, fboExtent, textures, appliesTo, geometryGrid), named parameter presets and descriptive metadata (description, author, version, category) are allowed through. Unknown top-level keys are accepted rather than rejected, so this schema will not catch a mis-spelled key such as "preset" for "presets". The loader ignores anything it does not know.

presets.description: Named parameter presets. Each value is a map of parameter id to value, naming a subset of the pack's declared parameters. A preset id is its key here, and it is also the label the picker shows, so it has to read as a name. That rules out control and bidi-formatting characters, and anything longer than a label can show. Unlike a user preset id it never becomes a filename, because duplicating a pack preset mints a fresh UUID. A null value is allowed and means the preset says nothing about that parameter, so it keeps the pack's default; the loader drops the entry. Those rules are checked by plasmazones-shader-validate rather than here, because the vendored JSON-schema validator rejects every name under a propertyNames rule, legitimate ones included.

type.description: Marshalling type of the uniform. An unknown type cannot be bound, so it is rejected.

default.description: Default value. Use a string for color (#rrggbb), a number for float or int, and a boolean for bool.
